name: hermit
description: A cost-optimized MCP coding executor for Claude Desktop.
long_description: Hermit keeps planning and final judgment in Claude while a configured local or lower-cost model executes bounded repository work.

executor_model.title: Executor model
executor_model.description: Optional. For example, qwen3-coder:30b for Ollama or coder-small for a compatible API. Leave blank to preserve Hermit settings.

executor_base_url.title: OpenAI-compatible base URL
executor_base_url.description: Optional. Provide this together with an executor model to use any compatible Chat Completions API.

executor_api_key.title: Executor API key
executor_api_key.description: Optional unless your executor endpoint requires authentication.

tools.name: run_task
tools.description: Start a bounded repository task with Hermit.

tools.name: check_task
tools.description: Get the status and result of a Hermit task.

tools.name: reply_task
tools.description: Provide requested input or a permission decision to a Hermit task.

tools.name: cancel_task
tools.description: Cancel a running or waiting Hermit task.
